commits.message:
fix(widgets): measuring draws nothing, and focus has no public blur the next frame undoes (rich-runtime-fna.4)

- Measurement.get and withBoundedWidth ask measure through measuring(),
  which drops onDraw: a StaticItem measuring by rendering no longer puts
  the widget it wraps in document order at measure time.
- FocusManager.blur is gone from the public surface: settle refocused the
  first widget on the next frame, so it never stuck. No focus is where
  settle leaves an app with nothing to focus.
- StaticItem's header no longer describes the deleted Screen.

fix(widgets): focus, hover and input follow the frame through review findings (rich-runtime-fna.4)

- App.refresh paints in a later task, not a microtask: a view that asks for
  a frame on every frame no longer starves stdin, so Ctrl+C still reaches it.
- settle keeps focus on a widget the view drew that the frame crops; Tab
  still moves among widgets on screen. Every focus move repaints, so settle
  judges a move onto a widget no frame has read.
- Hover is re-read off each painted frame under the last pointer position.
- The router subscribes before the app starts, so a first frame that throws
  is not followed by input re-engaging a stopped host.
- Overlays render with onDraw, so a widget inside one takes focus and clicks.
- paintLines uses Segment.getLineLength and Segment.divide in place of
  hand-rolled copies.

feat(widgets): WidgetApp routes focus and the pointer through the composed tree (rich-runtime-fna.4)

A widget now goes anywhere a renderable goes — a Panel, a Layout pane, a
Table cell — and still takes focus, keys and clicks. WidgetApp is an App
whose view has widgets in it: focus moves in document order among the
widgets on the painted frame (RenderOptions.onDraw), overlays are painted
after the view below their owner's footprint, and the pointer reaches the
innermost widget that drew the cell.

DefaultScreen, Screen, Placement, MountEntry and mount-driven focus
registration are deleted; the three demos that used them run on WidgetApp
with their layout expressed as Group / Columns / Layout. WidgetBase loses
`visible` — presence in the view is visibility.

App now owns pointer reporting: the alternate surface turns it on in
enter and off in leave, so every exit path hands it back; an inline frame
gets none, since it does not know its screen row. App gains onPaint, which
focus settles on. The router no longer touches raw mode or the mouse.

fix(table): a column with no cells to measure fills the offer (rich-table-3d3) (#204)

* fix(table): a column with no cells to measure fills the offer (rich-table-3d3)

* fix(table): an empty column fills in a pass of its own (rich-table-3d3)

Review: the fill as an inflated want skipped a minWidth and split an
expanding table's slack evenly. The want is the one cell again; fill is
the pass between natural widths and ratio shares, capped by maxWidth,
and the stretch weighs by the width each column holds.

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
